Hi Abhijit,

graphics are not implemented in Renjin. You can try to use a Java charting library to generate the graphs you need. I once combined Renjin with Processing.org to create a chart, the fruit of which can be found here: https://gist.github.com/mjkallen/8299891

Regards

Maarten-Jan
